summary: Iteration 8 validated: tipos catalog CRUD + cascade (rename propagates to molds.tipo, delete nulls molds.tipo); mold ancho/alto storage; tag schema simplified (no ancho/alto/color de pintura anywhere); reports/PDF/XLSX join molds properly. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases green. Frontend: TagSheet, MoldPicker (with embedded TipoPicker create/rename/delete inline), BulkTagModal, ReportsPage all confirmed free of legacy paint-color / ancho / alto inputs; end-to-end create-tipo-inline -> create-mold-1.5x3.0 -> save-tag flow works and 'Medidas del molde: 1.5 × 3 m (ancho × alto)' renders read-only from the mold. Discovered and FIXED one CRITICAL backend bug during testing: `Mold.tipo` was declared as required `str`, but the delete-tipo cascade sets it to None, which broke `Mold.from_mongo` and blew up `/api/molds`, `/api/report/molds`, and both exports with 500 (ValidationError). Changed to `Optional[str] = None` in /app/backend/server.py — after the fix all endpoints return 200 and all tests pass.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking the '+' inline-create button, the tipo is created and auto-selected as expected, but the dropdown does NOT auto-close. Because the dropdown overlays the mold form, it visually covers the 'Crear y usar' (mold-picker-new-save) button until the user clicks outside. Minor UX polish — click-outside works as fallback.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED HERE: Mold model had `tipo: str` (required) but delete_tipo cascade sets it to None → any list_molds/reports call after tipo deletion returned 500. Now `Optional[str] = None`. This is the same pattern that will bite again if MoldUpsert.tipo ever accepts None from clients — currently it validates against /api/tipos, so create-path is safe.
TipoPicker.handleCreate does not close the dropdown after creation; consider setOpen(false) for UX.
delete_tipo cascade leaves molds with tipo=null silently; consider returning affected mold count in response for admin awareness.

PUT /api/tags now ignores unknown fields (Pydantic default) — legacy clients sending ancho/alto/color get 200 but the fields are silently dropped; consider `model_config = {'extra': 'forbid'}` for stricter contract, or at least log a deprecation warning.

rca of the issue: SYMPTOM: GET /api/molds and /api/report/molds returned 500 after any DELETE /api/tipos/{name} whose tipo was in use. ROOT CAUSE: `delete_tipo` intentionally cascades `db.molds.update_many({tipo: name}, {$set: {tipo: null}})`, but the `Mold` pydantic model declared `tipo: str` (required non-null). So `fetch_molds_map` failed with `ValidationError: tipo Input should be a valid string, input_value=None` when hydrating the now-orphan mold. REPRO: (1) POST /api/tipos {name:'X'}, (2) POST /api/molds {name:'M', tipo:'X', color:'#000'}, (3) DELETE /api/tipos/X, (4) GET /api/molds → 500. FIX: change `Mold.tipo` to `Optional[str] = None` in /app/backend/server.py (line 297). After fix, GET /api/molds returns the orphan mold with tipo=null and all reports render '—' for tipo, matching the intended cascade behavior.
